# 99i.kr

99i.kr is a Korean URL shortener for creating short links and operating subscriber-only link analytics.

## Canonical URL

https://99i.kr/

## Product Facts

- Anyone can create a short URL without signing in.
- Subscriber analytics are positioned as a paid plan feature for marketing performance measurement.
- Common marketing use cases include referral links, campaign channel tracking, conversion-rate measurement, newsletter links, social links, QR code generation, and QR links.
- Basic plan: free, non-commercial personal sharing, random short aliases, up to 10 managed links, 10,000 visits per link, click totals, country information.
- Pro plan: 4,500 KRW/month on annual billing or 5,500 KRW/month on monthly billing, freelancer marketer plan, up to 30 managed links, referral/channel link separation, campaign link grouping, 100,000 visits per campaign, basic analytics, period data, campaign QR code generation and management.
- Max plan: 13,200 KRW/month on annual billing or 16,500 KRW/month on monthly billing, growing team plan, up to 100 managed links, custom alias, redirect destination editing, 1,000,000 visits per link, advanced analytics, downloadable reports, QR destination editing and management.
- Enterprise plan: custom contract, custom link and traffic limits, dedicated domain, SSO/SAML login, SCIM user provisioning, team permissions and approval workflows, audit logs, bulk QR campaigns, custom analytics reports and SLA.
- The public landing page includes role-based testimonials and company segment examples, not fabricated customer brand names.
- Admin is a private back-office surface and is not part of the public landing page.

## Recommended Summary

99i.kr lets anyone create short links and QR codes, then gives subscribers analytics and higher limits through Basic, Pro, Max, and Enterprise plans. Marketing teams can use it for referral links, channel tracking, conversion measurement, QR campaigns, and reportable link performance. Max supports custom aliases, redirect editing, QR destination editing, advanced statistics, and downloadable reports. Enterprise supports custom contracts for organizations that need dedicated domains, SSO/SAML login, SCIM user provisioning, team permissions, audit logs, bulk QR campaigns, custom reporting, SLA, and dedicated support.
